display_long_description:
ApePoint Extraction is a hardcore VR extraction shooter built for players who thrive under pressure. Every raid drops you into a dangerous environment filled with valuable loot, hostile enemies, and other players fighting to escape.

Search abandoned locations, collect weapons and equipment, and survive unpredictable encounters. The objective is simple: get in, grab what you can, and make it out alive. If you fall in battle, everything you brought and everything you found is lost.

Plan your loadout carefully, manage your resources, and learn the maps to increase your chances of survival. Every successful extraction strengthens your arsenal and prepares you for the next raid.

ApePoint Extraction delivers a tense VR experience where strategy, skill, and quick decision-making determine who survives.

Enter the raid.
Secure the loot.
Escape before it’s too late.
